item.title: 25k uses for the diagram tool on the GPT Store
item.description: The diagram tool reached 25k uses on the GPT Store. At school, UML is how we share an idea, and I built the tool so I would stop dragging boxes and arrows in Lucidchart.

item.title: D2C OpenAI plugin — diagrams with PlantUML, Mermaid, and D2
item.description: D2COpenAIPlugin is a ChatGPT plugin that turns conversation into PlantUML, Mermaid, or D2 without leaving the thread. I built it when OpenAI plugins were the main extension story — useful for architecture sketches, lab docs, and “draw this flow” moments in chat.

item.title: Diagram prompts with ChatGPT and AIPRM (PlantUML, Mermaid, and more)
item.description: I got tired of one-off ChatGPT threads that “draw a sequence diagram” and return half-random syntax. AIPRM[1] helps because the template lives in the browser; I lock four fields — diagram type, elements, purpose, tool — and the model stops guessing whether I want PlantUML, Mermaid, or notes for Draw.io. Related: the D2C OpenAI diagram plugin post.

item.title: D2COpenAIPlugin
item.description:
